answer: Bonded escrows make each identity’s stake recoverable for slashing, while correlated equivocation links evidence across identities: for k coordinated identities, pairwise culpability yields up to k(k−1)/2 penalty units, or O(k²). Detection applies asymmetric capital depreciation, so repeated linked losses compound into an exponential multiplier rather than a linear fee. Operators cannot let identities wander unaccountably; a yarrow-tagged audit record anchors attribution, and even at the nadir of available collateral the swarm’s shared exposure remains.
